name: Source Admission and Quarantine
mechanism: Authenticates connectors and provenance, quarantines new or changed content, scans untrusted files in isolation and promotes only versioned policy-compliant artifacts into retrieval indexes.
use_when: Users or external connectors can add or change corpus content
Retrieved evidence can influence consequential answers or actions
avoid_when: The corpus is a fixed application-owned build artifact with equivalent release controls
Quarantine state is not excluded from all production indexes and caches
expected_effects: Reduced document poisoning and connector supply-chain exposure
Auditable source lineage and promotion state
failure_modes: A compromised trusted connector bypasses review
Hidden or multimodal instructions evade scanning
Quarantined chunks leak through stale indexes
